interface.title: GelFigure (v0.6.14)
interface.field: Molecular biology: agarose DNA gels and SDS-PAGE protein gels
interface.stage_of_work: Turning raw gel images into publication figures, after imaging and before manuscript submission
interface.what_it_is_for: A browser tool that takes a raw gel image and turns it into a journal-ready, labelled figure. It straightens and crops the gel, finds the lanes, identifies the ladder, adds annotations, runs an image-integrity check and exports the figure with a processing log.

data.note: Loaded with ?demo=1, which opens the built-in synthetic gel demo_gel.tif (16-bit, 1400×1000, 11 wells, GeneRuler 1 kb Plus ladder in well 1, 358 saturated pixels in lane 8, an empty well 5). It was detected as DNA with 100% confidence and auto-rotated −1.3°. Files downloaded: demo_gel_figure_600dpi.png, demo_gel_figure.svg, demo_gel_figure.pptx, demo_gel_processing_log.json and demo_gel.gelfig (the project file).

tree.specific: Turn demo_gel.tif into a straightened, cropped, ladder-calibrated, annotated gel figure and export it as PNG/SVG/PPTX with a processing log

features.name: Sample-type classifier with manual override
features.general: Automatically classify the kind of sample in an image, show the confidence and reasons, and let the user override it so units and reference standards switch to match
features.specific: 'Gel type detected 100%' with reasons, DNA (bp) / Protein (kDa) buttons, 'Switched to protein mode' toast, marker labels switching between bp and kDa
steps: Read the detected gel type, confidence and reasons
Press Protein (kDa) or DNA (bp) to override
Check that the marker labels switch unit
serves_tasks: Confirm or override the automatically detected sample type

features.name: Contrast levels with clipping and saturation monitor
features.general: Set the black and white display limits on a histogram while live counts show how much signal is clipped or saturated; overlay saturated pixels; auto-reset
features.specific: Black/White point sliders over a histogram, the 'Camera saturation · Contrast clipping' readout, Show saturated pixels (red), Auto for current crop, Reset contrast, and Gamma locked behind Unlock
steps: Tick Show saturated pixels to see sensor-saturated areas
Drag the White or Black point slider
Read the clipping % and the warning toast
Press Auto for current crop or Reset contrast
serves_tasks: Adjust contrast while watching clipping

features.name: Rotation with auto-straighten and grid
features.general: Rotate an image by slider or number against a grid, with a one-click automatic angle
features.specific: Rotation slider, −/+ buttons and number box, Grid checkbox, Auto straighten / Back to auto angle, and 90° turns and flips
steps: Type or drag a rotation angle
Tick Grid to judge alignment
Press Auto straighten
serves_tasks: Straighten a tilted image

features.name: Lane grid with linked spacing and crop box
features.general: Overlay evenly spaced sample columns on an image, adjust their number and end positions, re-detect them automatically, and crop the region used for the figure
features.specific: Blue lane lines and red crop box on the raw image, Lanes −/＋, Link end-lane spacing, Re-detect lanes + markers in crop, ↺ undo
steps: Change the lane count or drag an end lane line
Press Re-detect lanes + markers in crop
Drag a corner of the red crop box
Undo with ↺ or Control+z if needed
serves_tasks: Fix the number and spacing of sample positions
Crop the figure area

features.name: Lane exclusion with visible splice marks
features.general: Remove a sample column from the figure and mark where the image was cut, so the splice is disclosed to readers
features.specific: Lane visibility and advanced tools, the 'Well 5 looks empty' Remove prompt, per-lane Show ticks, and the 'Where lanes were cut' White gap / Thin line styles
steps: Open Lane visibility and advanced tools
Press Remove on the empty-well prompt or untick a lane's Show box
Choose White gap or Thin line for the splice
serves_tasks: Exclude an empty sample position and mark the cut

features.name: Ladder library matching with fit score
features.general: Match the detected bands of a reference lane to a chosen size standard, see a fit score, and choose which sizes are labelled and in what unit
features.specific: Marker card: marker lane, Ladder model list (23 commercial ladders plus Custom ladder), Fit %, Detect bands here, the Bands list with matched ticks, bp/kb/bp-kb units, Thin labels, Re-match, and Calibrate / reference
steps: Pick the marker lane
Choose a ladder model and read the Fit %
Tick or untick bands to label
Switch the unit
Press Thin labels if labels overlap
serves_tasks: Pick the reference standard and check the fit
Choose which reference sizes are labelled and in what unit
Inspect the reference lane against the standard's band diagram

features.name: Bulk label paste with inline rich text
features.general: Fill all column labels from one pasted spreadsheet row, with simple markup for italics, then set the angle for all labels
features.specific: Paste names box (tabs, commas or new lines; *lacZ* = italic), Fill names, Edit names popover (size, colour, super/subscript), and Name angle (Auto/0–90°)
steps: Press Paste names
Paste or type the names row
Press Fill names
Set Name angle
serves_tasks: Name every sample at once
Set the label angle and fonts

features.name: Condition matrix row
features.general: Add a named row of per-sample +/− cells above the columns and click each cell to cycle its state
features.specific: Condition row: click cells on the figure to cycle + / − / empty and name the row (EcoRI)
steps: Press Condition row
Click cells to cycle + / −
Type the row name
serves_tasks: Add treatment and group annotations above the samples

features.name: Size-estimating target arrow
features.general: Click a feature in a calibrated image to get its size estimated from the reference standard, shown as a labelled arrow
features.specific: Target band: click a band to get an arrowhead with the estimated size (2.2 kb), with mark style, side, size and colour options
steps: Press Target band
Click a band on the figure
Check or edit the estimated size label
Press Done
serves_tasks: Mark features inside the image

features.name: Region box with zoom inset
features.general: Draw a rectangle around a region of interest and optionally place an enlarged copy beside the figure
features.specific: Region box: drag a rectangle on the raw image, set Dashed line and Enlarge ×2, and a matching inset appears to the right
steps: Press Region box
Drag a rectangle on the raw image
Choose the line style and Enlarge ×2
Press Done
serves_tasks: Mark features inside the image

features.name: Side bracket and group line annotations
features.general: Mark a vertical range or a span of columns with a bracket or line and a label
features.specific: Side bracket (drag top-to-bottom on the raw image, label Smear) and Group line (drag across lane names, label WT); both are listed in the sidebar annotation list
steps: Choose Side bracket or Group line
Drag over the range or the lane names
Type the label
Press Done or Enter
serves_tasks: Add treatment and group annotations above the samples
Mark features inside the image

features.name: Journal-width layout with effective-resolution readout
features.general: Size a figure to a journal column width and see the effective image resolution and label collisions update
features.specific: Layout: Auto width / Gel width mm, the Column list (85/120/180 mm), Effective gel resolution dpi, Panel letter, Frame, and Numbering
steps: Choose a column width
Read the effective dpi and any overlap warning
Add a panel letter and frame
serves_tasks: Fit the figure to a journal column

features.name: Pre-flight integrity check
features.general: Before any export, list image-integrity warnings and disclosure notes, and let the user go back and fix them or proceed knowingly
features.specific: Pre-flight check dialog: Warning entries (camera saturation, marker-label overlap), Note entries (lanes removed), Go back and fix, Export anyway
steps: Start any export
Read the Warning and Note entries
Press Go back and fix or Export anyway
serves_tasks: Review integrity warnings before export

features.name: Multi-format export with processing log
features.general: Export the figure in raster, vector and slide formats plus a machine-readable record of every processing parameter for the methods or supplement
features.specific: Export PNG at 300/600/1200 dpi, ▾ menu for PPTX/TIFF/SVG/Uncropped image/Original data/Processing log JSON (SHA-256, levels, clipping, lanes, markers, annotations), and auto-written Legend notes
steps: Choose the export dpi
Press Export PNG or choose a format from ▾
Pass the pre-flight check
Export the Processing log for the supplement
serves_tasks: Export the figure in several formats with a methods record

features.name: Project file with embedded original image
features.general: Save the whole editing session, including the untouched source image, as one file that can be reopened later
features.specific: File → Save project… writes a .gelfig that includes the original image ('Project saved (includes the original image…)' toast)
steps: Open the File menu
Press Save project…
Read the confirmation toast
serves_tasks: Save the work to resume later
